GoalkeeperKick.approved_cut: 40-99 inclusive; exactly 60 samples, 59 intervals. Earlier cuts and blend scene range are not used.

FallLoop.derivation: Source airborne frames 1-3 ping-pong at 6x slower sampling; vertical ballistic root removed. Frames 4-8 approach ground; first contact is frame 9. Not a dedicated authored cyclic fall.

Landing.derivation: Starts on source first foot-contact frame 9; runs once only after real floor contact.

AirSideKick.approval: User: not an up attack or a down attack, just a side kick, mid air. Airborne neutral/horizontal F only.
AirSideKick.impact_basis: Maximum right-foot forward reach relative to hips among approved samples, frame 42; no visual approval claimed.
AirSideKick.object_transform_policy: Carrier object transform excluded; installed master transform retained.
AirSideKick.root_policy: All hips translation removed; fighter controller owns horizontal and ballistic travel.

mesh_preservation: Animation-only merge into original installed GLB; mesh, skin, materials, images and old animations unchanged.
